title: Monuments and markers
text:
19.23.050 Monuments and markers.
Requirements. The location of all monuments shall be in accordance with the SDM and is subject to approval by the city manager or designee.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008; Ord. No. 19327, § 41, 4-26-2022)
Chapter 19.24 MOUNTAIN DEVELOPMENT AREA (MDA) STANDARDS
